notes.title: #UPDATE 0.29a - Performance and changes
notes.notes:
Hey! How is it going?

So here we go again, here you have a new update, but remember, as I said in the last post, these updates are going to "change" the game for the new coming version.

However, you are getting a big performance gap between this new version and the last one, and more performance is coming.

This update contains a bunch of techinical stuff that you might not understand (or you might do), but it should be doing a great job anyway.

[h1]Performance[/h1]
Voxel system is being reworked and optimized. The game modes we have in mind require a constant, stable fps rate and our goal is to get the best we can.

Some UI and AI is being reworked too, and they will be improved a lot in the upcoming updates.

[h1]Content removed[/h1]
Don't kill me yet! Wait!
I'm removing some content from the game for a simple reason. This content is causing a lot of performance spikes and as I said, our current main goal is to reach a stable performance rate. This content will be coming back as soon as I get it running smoothly, so don't worry!

[h1]Some bugs may appear[/h1]
Big, huge changes are being done in One Last Day, so you might see some new bugs. Some are known, some are unknown yet, but the "known" ones aren't making the game unplayable.

Of course these will be solved in the upcoming updates until the new version comes.

[h1]Simplified patch notes[/h1]
- Lightning bolt removed (it was using the old particle system and procedural mesh movement, performance expensive)
- Texture atlas references is now a separated class declared only once, instead for each chunk
- Texture atlas references are now a custom struct instead of Vector2 class
- Physx Unity system is being replaced by a custom voxel collision system, it might be buggy at the moment
- Custom collider systems now uses primitive colliders pools and voxel detection instead of mesh colliders
- Skeletons meshes removed, they were very expensive in performance and their material (item) will be added in other loot pools
- Each chunk is now updated (checking for changes and rebuild mesh) 1 time every X frames, instead of X times every 1 frame
- Particle raycasting (for raining and fire) optimized
- Grass and vegetation meshes are not generating mesh colliders anymore
- General code cleaning from the previously removed old networking system
- Texture atlas reduced from 4k to 2k, gaining a great performance in RAM and no loss on quality
- UI Event System optimized for the current UI system
- Enemy sound event system (sound detection) executed every X frames instead of X times every frame
- Sun flare removed (will be replaced with another effect)
- Added a probability spawn rate to clouds to reduce acid clouds
- Damage produced by acid cloud deactivated temporarily
- Updated to Unity 5.6.2 (added GPU instancing for some meshes / materials)

KNOWN BUGS / PROBLEMS
- Mesh colliders are removed from terrain and replaced with voxel detection + primitive colliders, beware of strange physics behaviours
- Some textures from some old models might be missing (these models are going to be replaced)
- Some animations might be broken, but still playable


I hope this update makes your game run better!

notes.title: [Progress] Big changes
notes.notes:
Hi! Long time without an update.

My life has become a bit more complicated and I have less time to develop the game, but it's still under development, of course!

And talking about development, I'm here to tell you about a few changes than may change the game how looks, feels and plays.

[h1]Traveling around the map[/h1]
As you know, I have an infinite map on OLD working (not yet published, but working). This map is going to change a lot from the old system.

When I was testing this new infinite map, I found the map boring, nothing to do, no progress. Yes, the essence is still the same, survive, but I wanted more, a partial goal or objectives to be done.

So now we are talking about "pseudo-biomes". Don't expect biomes like other games, as instead, these zones will be some kind of map objective to be completed, for example a small town to be saved from some kind of enemy, an infected zone where you have to deactivate some kind of device, etc...

This way you will gain access to a new safe zone to build and manage as you want. You will be still able to build wherever you want, whatever you want, but inside these safe zones you can build some pre-made buildings with a special function (refinery, resources producement, etc...).

[h1]A better looking map[/h1]
Since I can blend models and other stuff with the terrain using this new system, I'm improving stuff like adding minerals (not only textures, but with 3d models blended), better rocks to be collected on the surface, and maybe even different types of trees, grass and flowers, so you may expect big changes on how the game looks (or not so big)


[h1]So...[/h1]
So the goal is to make an insteresting sandbox mode, with a good looking map and making the fact of exploration something that you will want to do, or the fact of staying at the same place and make your own town enjoyable, changing the way that the game is played right now and adding some task other than survive.


Sorry, no screenshots yet! I'm making some testing with all above and as soon I have something that looks really good I'll show you everything!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.28a - Red Moon Week and French!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The last night (at least it was night in Spain) I updated the game with a few bug fixing stuff but also activating the Red Moon Week event and adding another language, french! (thank you AwReel for the translation!)

[h1]Red Moon Week[/h1]

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/rmw.png[/img]

[i]Once every year, every pumpkin arise and come to live to get revenge. You have eaten their family, their friends, and now they will eat you. When the Red Moon comes the worst nightmares awake and you better hide or be ready to fight.[/i]

You may know this event from the last year. This week you will be able to create a new map, and when starting you will be asked if you want to convert that map into a Halloween event map. It wiill be turned into a normal one after the event is finished, so no worries!

On the event map you'll see different textures and a new enemy spawning, Pumpkin Zombie. They are quite stronger and dangerous than usual zombies, but their loot is always better with a chance of dropping a Pumpkin Helmet, that lights up an area around you!

[h1]French is now supported[/h1]
[b]Every french user should now thanks AwReel for translating the game into french[/b], thank you very much! French is now supported and you can now play the game is this language by setting it in Steam, awesome!

[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]
More bugs have been fixed, but remember, I'm making HUGE changes to the game, so you may see more bugs now than ever and I'll try to fix them all, but trust me, all this changes coming will be really worth.


And now go for it, hunt some pumpkins! Good luck!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.27a - New stuff with a deep cleaning
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm here again to bring you yet another update to keep improving.

The first thing and most notable, game now supports multiple languages.

[h1]Multi language support[/h1]
Starting with spanish, OLD finally supports more language translations. Some members of our community asked me access to these files, so they can make their own translation, and this was a time ago.

So yes, anyone who's willing to do it, can now translate the whole game into him / her language!

Maybe you've heard from me that I want to get an official translation, but it's way expensive for my pocket right now. In the meanwhile, if a translation is made by the community, I'll add that language to the game and the name of the community / translator to the game also.

All text files can be found under your installation path, 90% of the cases found under this path

[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\One Last Day\Text[/i]

Keep close attetion to a file named [b][i]"README - Guideness to translate"[/i][/b], very, very recommended to open these files with Notepad++.

[h1]Some UI is changed, updated[/h1]
In order to allow text load more languages, I needed to update some UI and adapt it to allow more text inside it (or auto-adapt in most of cases).

You'll see some differences and improvements in the current UI system.

[h1]Big cleaning, optimization[/h1]
Another thing is that I've cleaned A LOT of code, simplified some, and replaced a lot of asynchronous calls with a faster synchronous system.

Also the old networking system has been removed almost completely in preparation to the new Steam P2P system. This improves performance but can cause some bugs, some of them known.

And also I've removed A LOT of unused assets, obsolete shaders, and materials.

All of this should improve your game performance, but it's also good because this means that big things are coming to OLD!

[h1]Little additions[/h1]
I've added quite new text to the game with new descriptions and changed some of them.

A new voxel damage system was added too, in preparation to the new multiplayer system and infinite map. This system is not finished, but it works very well.

Also a warning, reminder of the night is coming was added. It's an alarm sound with a notification to warn you about the night and encouraging to find a place to hide.




No screenshots in this update post! But I ensure you, the changes in the game in this update were one of the biggest ever made since today.

Hope you enjoy! As always, here you have the patch notes.

[b]0.27[/b]
- Obsolete networking system (Unity's old system) has been removed from the game almost completely
- Started the implementation of the p2p Steam networking system on the new character system
- WARNING: since the network system is removed, some bugs and incosistences may appear, report them!
- WARNING: project cleaning phase 2 completed, report any missing textures!
- Huge code cleaning, game should run even smoother now
- A lot of asynchronous code has been replaced for a much faster, synchronous code, game should respond quite faster now
- Custom airplane orders are working again now
- New, more immersive voxel damage effect added. Instead of a cracking texture, you'll see the same cube moving (unfinished)
- Note: the new voxel damage system was done for the new upcoming infinte map, this system may causes some little bugs with the current map system
- Added a new text system to allow further languages support through Steam
- Text files can be found under "GameInstallationFolder/text/" now
- Spanish language is now officially supported supported (esES)
- A lot of UI were adjusted and modified to allow further languages
- Added a translation guideness to help you translate the game in case that you want to (under installation path > One Last Day > Text)
- Added a moving effect to Ricardo's memories images
- Dialog UI was adjusted to make text more visible
- All clothes received a description text and translation location, finally!
- Scavenger weapons received a description text and translation location too
- An alarm sound with a warning will pop up when night is close
- Firearms should be working again now
- Headshot experience bonus should be working correctly now

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.26a - Fixing and optimizing a bit more
notes.notes:
How's going today?

As I said, here's another update, but no big new features in this one, just fixes, a bit of optimization and some changes that you may like (or not! wuahaha)

[h1]Free scavenger weapons DLC for everyone![/h1]
Maybe you've seen that the game is under promotion, still going until it's out of alpha stage.

For purchasing the game you were getting two weapons with unique skins, the scavenger weapons. These weapons were granted before once you logged in into the game and checked that you own the game through internet, but since internet is no longer needed, how can we check it?

[b]The answer is a free DLC for a limited time.[/b]

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/scv.jpg[/img]

So if you don't have it already, keep an eye, it should be published very soon (in a few minutes / hours) and get it free! Don't worry, you have time.


[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/scavengerRam.jpg[/img]

[h1]Once installed, how to get them in the game?[/h1]
When you install this DLC a new tab will appear inside the game (sandbox), with a "present" icon. Just click it and a reward window will pop up.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/rewards.jpg[/img]

You can claim them as many times as you want, but you can't use them for crafting, no dropping, and no storing in any storage container. You can delete them and equip them with any problems, if you don't use them and need that space in your inventory, you can delete them and claim them again later!

[h1]Fixes, improvements, a bit of optimization[/h1]
And more stuff!

[b]Audio settings[/b]
You can now tweak some audio values (music volume for main menu and general volume by now). I'll be adding more options in a future.

[b]Optimization for the current map system[/b]
As you know, map system will be completely changed but in the meanwhile I want this one to be working the best as I can do it work. So I've reduced the number of threads and calls to the map generation and deactivated the water rendering temporarily (the game has almost no water). This improve the performance a bit or a lot, depending on your computer.

[b]Tweaks[/b]
Sprint is not related to your FPS anymore. Before, the more FPS you had, the faster it was recovering, and that's not fair! Also, I've made it a bit harder. Sprints is recovering faster, but lasts less.

I've tweaked' a bit the mouse cursor too for those that have 2 monitors and the cursor were going out, this should fix it almost completely, test it and give me your feedback!

The new directory system is now fully implemented, and settings are saving / loading correctly now. You can delete the old "OLD" folder safely now!

And a bit of this, a bit of that... check the full patch notes for more information about this "mini" patch!


[b]0.26a[/b]
- WARNING: "scavenger axe and crossbow" is now a DLC (free) because the offline mode recently added
- Chunk generation optimized, only one call to the main thread is now required
- Water generation deactivated temporarily until it's fully implemented to improve performance
- Added a music manager (singleton), volume configuration and further music support is now possible
- Added a new tab to claim game rewards (early access axe, crossbow and future rewards)
- DLC items cannot be dropped, stored or used for crafting, just deleted, and they can be claimed as many times as you want
- Game cursor should be now locked when it's hidden and free when it's shown (to avoid problems with multiple screens)
- Solved a bug reducing to 0 the base stack of some items instead of the ones stored in your inventory
- The game will know when you map were generated and the "First generation window" won't show if you map were generated before
- Exit to main menu and close game inside the sandbox editor are now under the section Audio / * - Miscelanea options
- "Jump on head" system is now fixed and you need to actually jump over a zombie's head to make the kick work
- Sprint decay and recover is now fixed per time and not per frames per second (players with better fps were recovering way faster)
- Sprint adjusted to make the game just a bit harder. Keep your breath inside you just for in case you need it
- Zombies have reminded boxing. Fixed the bug making them peaceful beasts when you were quiet and still
- Bug fix, when trying to unequip a one handed weapon it remains equipped, but the slot was emptied
- Another bug fix, time won't reset to 9am everytime you enter your anymore, so time is saved!
- Input configuration is now saved under the new directory structure system
- Spawn configuration uses the new directory system too
- Hotkey bar is using also the new directory system, so you can delete the old directory safely now
- Main menu illumination tweaked
- Inventory is now safely saved each 10 seconds
- Project cleaning phase 1 completed


This update should be running right now. Free DLC should be coming in a few minutes / hours too, remember to get it!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.24a - More stuff!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! How are you doing?

Here we come with another update, this time, adding a bit of new content to the game, let's check it out, shall we?

[h1]New enemy, a static spitter![/h1]
Adding new enemies to the game is one of our main task to get exploration exciting and dangerous. This time is the turn of the ceiling creature, a spitter.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/ceilingSpitter.png[/img]

It's spawning inside buildings and caves, on the ceiling. It cannot move or see, but they can smell you and hear you, so if you get close enough, they will spit acid to the ground. This acid is a bit different, it will set you on fire (green flames!) if it touches you, so be careful.

It's very weak and not very common, but still a danger in your exploration journey.

[h1]A little one, but funny, head kick![/h1]
It was quite easy escape zombies by riding them, right? You wont be able to do this anymore, but instead you'll kick them in the head, causing damage and triggering another little jump.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/headKick.png[/img]

Jump on their heads like that famous plumber!

[h1]Improved animal AI, better hunting[/h1]
As you know we improved the enemy AI allowing you to sneak behind them and not being detected unless you make some noise or they see you.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/newHunting.png[/img]

Now this is possible with any wild life! Also, like enemies do, they will be facing their new direction while turning softly, so their movement looks way smoother.

[h1]More stuff![/h1]
With the new cooking system we're adding more recipes on almost every update to get it growing, this time is...carrot soup! Yumm

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/carrotSoup.png[/img]

cooked carrots + water bowl + seeds...

Also, improving more the interface, we've added some scrollbars to make navigation trough lists easier.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/scrollbars.png[/img]

You can click and drag these scrollbars to scroll down or up.


And one last thing, some users complaint about torches and campfires insta-exploding under acid rain, so we changed this. As instead, it will make a fire crack (damaging a bit this item and if you are near too), lighting it off.
Acid with fire is still dangerous in some cases, be careful!


[b]And what else? We've tweaked, fixed and added some minor things, check the update notes with the most important additions![/b]
- Added a draggable scrollbar to the news panel, crafting recipe list, object option list panel and the store
- "Tip" text (while loading) adapted for every resolution
- "Posing" marker (blue / red) is now always visible, not affected by lighting
- You can now drag and drop items within the crafting menu without getting them dropped
- Item icon text name changed to hide partially the icon and show the name
- The text with the item's name from the shop's item element has been centered
- Some UI elements adjusted for lower resolutions
- Added "head kick" when jumping on a zombie's head, triggering another jump and hitting them (weak damage)
- Head kick won't damage helmet wearing enemies
- New enemy added: ceiling creature, a static spitter!
- Ceiling creature cannot move, and cannot see, just hear and smell
- Ceiling creature will spit processed acid, that will spread "green" fire around the crash zone
- Ceiling creature will die if it can't be attached to any ceiling
- Bug fix, recipes should be now loading correctly
- New recipe added: carrot soup (cooked carrots + water bowl + seeds)
- By adding a stack of the same ingredient / fuel to the campfire while there's another one of the same type will stack them now
- Boars will now hit you if you are on their way while they are running
- Pheasants are now weaker
- Boars are now weaker
- Boars will now drop the correct meat
- Wild life will now turn softly to face their new direction like enemies do
- Hunting is now easier and funnier! You can now sneak from animals like how you do with enemies, they can see and hear
- Acid rain wont insta-explode campfires and torches anymore, instead they will make fire cracks before it lights off



As always, we are uploading this update right now and it will be availabe on next hour!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.23a - Cooking system!
notes.notes:
Hi future colonizers!

Here we come with another update with new content and features. 
As you know we're adding features that are on a list until we reach beta stage, and then we'll keep adding but we'll focus on bug fixing / make the game stable. 

This time is cooking turn.

[h1]Lets cook! Improving campfires[/h1]
In a game where you need to survive campfires are one of the most important things that you can use at the beggining. In O.L.D campfires where just a source of light, but not anymore, because now campfires restores your energy and protects you from nearby enemies.

And now you are able to cook food! For now, you can only cook turnips, carrots and meat, and make some delicious Turnip Stew. Don't worry, we're adding more things to cook very soon! Take the time to cook something because it's worth it.

[b]Campfires will need fuel in order to burn.[/b] Until now they were infinite, but not anymore, you'll need to use fuel to keep the fire alive. You can use sticks, cloth, raw wood or coal, being sticks the worst fuel (but the easiest to get) and coal the best one.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/cookingTurnip.jpg[/img]

You can get coal by "cooking" (burning) raw wood as ingredient. Also every single cooked ingredient will be turned into coal if they stay on the fire for a while after they are ready.

[b]Also, note that there's only one recipe for campfires now[/b]

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/newRecipeCampfire.jpg[/img]

Those 15 sticks you need will be used as fuel when you place your crafted campfires, so you can recover them if you want.

In the other hand, you can't recover a campfire once is placed, as instead, you can salvage it, recovering some of the materials and anything that in inside in that moment.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/campfireOptions.jpg[/img]


[h1]Is that everything?[/h1]
Not even close. This new system opens a new way to new more systems, advanced crafting and weapon customization.

We're going to start to implement the infinite map system, but we've talked and we're pulling another update before doing that with new additions like a new enemy (static enemy) and maybe the weapon customization system (attach accesories) along with some improvements to the UI that a lot of you asked us!

And as always, here you have the most important patch notes!
- You can now bind your mouse keys (left click, right click, and wheel click)
- All controls can be reseted to defaults with the "Defaults" button now
- Bug fix, activating default dynamic object behaviour even if you kept use button pressed
- Bug fix, placing indicator won't explode mines anymore
- Bug fix, mines will explode again agaisnt enemies and wild life
- Bug fix, broken boxes pieces will now collide each other avoiding clipping
- Bug fix, hands stuck while jumping and attacking solved
- Bug fix, door item was referencing another item instead of itself
- Bug fix, some recipes where causing problems locking items in your inventory
- Added cooking system!
- Turnips, carrots and hard meat can now be cooked at campfires
- Sticks, raw wood, clothes and coal can now be used as fuel for campfires
- New items added: cooked turnip, cooked carrot, steak, turnip stew
- Raw wood can be "cooked" (burnt) at campfires as ingredient to get coal
- Every fuel item have now efficiency, sticks burn for a few seconds while coal last for a long time
- Campfires now need any kind of fuel to burn inside the cooking menu
- Cooking progress and fuel consumption will only happen if your campfire is burning
- Added a sound when you are cooking
- There's only one recipe to make campfires now: Wood (3) + Stone (2) + Stick (15)
- Campfires cannot be picked up when placed anymore, instead they can be salvaged, getting some materials back on the ground
- When you place a campfire, it will use the 15 sticks you needed to craft it as fuel
- Item info text (when pointing a placed object) changed
- When dragging an item from a container to a shortcut slot it will be returned to the container's slot instead of dropping it
- If you try to put an item from a container slot into a shortcut slot you will be prompted that you need to drag it first to the inventory


Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.21a - A little one to end the year
notes.notes:
Happy new year! Well... not yet, but in a few hours :)

To end the year I bring you a very little update but with great upgrades!

[h1]Improved and fixed crafing[/h1]
After some problems and unfinished stuff, crafting should now be working as expected, and also enjoy the new filters for the known recipes!

[h1]Improved Airplane Store (A.S.)[/h1]
I almost named is A.S.S. (Airplane Supplies Store), but you can imagine why not xD.

As you know there's a in-game store where you can spend the coins you collected in new items, an airplane will deliver them to you wherever you are.
This shop had every (or almost) item in the game, and this could be a little game breaking feature.

To solve this, A.S. is offering new stock with random items every time you enter the game or also every morning in the game!

Also this store had received new filters, working a lot better than the previous filters.

[h1]Are you sneaky? Your lucky day![/h1]
Yes, you can now sneak behind your enemies without alerting them! Enemies have now vision and a visible range (angle and distance). Also, your character will make dynamic noise. Let me explain how it works.

[b]Example 1-[/b] Character not moving, standing up, enemy close but can't see you, you won't be detected unless you move.
[b]Example 2-[/b] Crouching (lying) and moving, you can almost touch the back of your enemies if they can't see you.
[b]Example 3-[/b] Same as 1 but your enemy is an "Infected Survivor"... run for your life.

Enemies have dynamic radius of sound and vision, so an "Infected survivor" will detect you much better than a "Armored infected".

[b]But hey! those enemies were turning too fast and too frequent![/b]
Don't worry, enemies will be turning taking more time between each one. Also, they won't be turning in an instant, as instead they will be slowly turning into their new direction now, letting you avoid them easily.

[h1]Bug fixes and some optimizations[/h1]
As always, this update contains a few more bug fixes and optimizations, however expect more into this update (named 0.21f1) coming next to this!


And to finish, here you have some notes!:
0.21
- Added filters to the crafting menu
- Once a day (or once you enter the world) the airplane store will randomize its stock
- The airplane store (A.S.) have new working filters now!
- New "walk over high grass" sounds added
- Added more item descriptions
- Infected survivors will now have random beards
- Bug fix - duplication bug caused when trying to fill bottles solved
- Bug fix - solved a bug that was auto-deleting placed stuff
- Enemies will avoid spawning underground (where there's no terrain at all) for a few seconds from their spawn
- Crafting deeply revised, multiple bugs solved
- Enemy AI improved, they will turn slowly to their new direction instead of instant rotation
- Enemy AI improved, they can see you if you are near enough
- Enemies will now have a more randomized period to start walking or stop while unalerted
- Dynamic player sound radius, you will cause less sound while crouching and more while sprinting
- You can now sneak from enemies by crouching and making the less possible sound while they can't see you
- You can now stand behind of a zombie without being detected if you don't move (not for infected survivors)


Uploading update, should be available in a few minutes.

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.19a - Welcome, Mac users!
notes.notes:
It is always good to keep growing and get the game going available even for more people, and that's why if you are a proud owner of a Macintosh, then let me say: welcome to One Last Day!

This update comes with even more content, as always, so sit down and start reading, it is worth the time.

[h1]Mac version[/h1]
This is the first and the most important new "feature" available now in O.L.D. Mac users are now able to play the game, but hey, if you have also a PC remember that you won't loose your characters, they will stay saved online.
This is the very first version of Mac, so please be aware that we will be working on further optimization and possible bug fixes, but it has been tested and it's fully playable if you are between the minimum requirements.

[h1]Interactive dynamic objects[/h1]
You've asked for it, then here you go! If you have placed a torch, campfire, antenna, bed and now you can to move, don't worry, keep pressed E key to open a new interaction pannel that will allow you more options with that object.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/interaction.jpg[/img]

You will find that some items, like torches and campfires will have also an extra option like turn on / off. [b]Just doing a fast tap on the E key will activate the default option of that item[/b], so don't worry, you don't need to open a interface panel every time you want to light a torch or open a door.

[h1]Talking about campfires[/h1]
Until now it was used only to light a wide area, but now it is more useful than ever (and it will be even more soon). Tired of those zombies coming for underground to kill you? Want to make a camp outside in the forest but those zombies are always there? Don't worry! Now campfires will avoid these zombies coming from underground while you are within its range and also it is burning, of course.

Also, [b]staying within the range of the campfire will replenish your energy gradually[/b], so come closer and take a break.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/campfire.jpg[/img]

Yes, it is wonderfull, but we're making things to react each other in the world, starting with fire (right now, torches and campfires). If they are under rain, don't try to make them work, they will extinguish, and of course, no effect or light is coming out. But be even more afraid from acid rain now.
[b]Acid rain will react agaisnt the fire, making a small explosion when colliding.[/b] This explosive feature is for now only working with placed torches and campfires, so try to get them in a place with a roof or extinguish them manually if you see the storm coming.

[h1]I love rain![/h1]
And that's why now you can again fill your bottles and bowls if you are under the rain (just use them like a regular item), and also staying under the rain your thirst will be gone gradually, so open your mouth and drink that rain! Well... no mouth in your character I guess... =)

[h1]A new chat system, bye bye old one[/h1]
This is not a really big change but needed since we have changed almost every UI item, so it's looking more integrated and quite better now. This new chat system is still in experimental stage, just like multiplayer, so expect a lot of improvements and fixes once we reach beta stage.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/smallchat.jpg[/img]

There are a few more things on this update, and other few that we're preparing for a lot of new features that are coming really soon.

[b]Before leaving, in case that you have missed it, take a look to the last biggest additions / changes on One Last Day![/b]

[h1]A whole new interface, inventory and crafting system[/h1]
Inventory with slots, draggable windows, recipe learning system, shortcut key bar, better take a look by yourself.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/craft.jpg[/img]

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/windows.jpg[/img]

[h1]New NPC spawn system[/h1]
Tired of being alone around you? This new spawn system will take care of that and will bring you some company always!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/notalone.jpg[/img]

[h1]Some optimization tweaks, added more options to settings menu[/h1]
It is really important to get the game smoothly running for you, so this is one of our main tasks, thats why we have improve performance and added some more graphical options that you can tweak to improve your experience.


[h1]But the best thing is coming next...[/h1]
We have a lot of new features and suprises coming soon! You will be enjoying One Last Day more than ever really soon...

[i]Some short, quick patch notes[/i]
0.19a
- Mac version supported - First version, optimization and further support coming along
- Infinite levels for your characters (in preparation for character progression)
- You can know open an interaction panel with dynamic objects (torches, doors, beds...) by holding E
- Doing a fast tap to E will activate main dynamic object action (light on / off, open, set spawn point...)
- Added the option to pick up a dynamic object back from the world
- Increased spawner's spawn rate, spawn quantity remains untouched
- You are now able to light on / off placed torches and campfires
- New campfire FX effect
- Staying within the range of a campfire will now recover your energy gradually (while lighted)
- Staying within the range of a campfire will now avoid zombies coming from underground (while lighted)
- Steam achievement "Saving the carrots" changed from 200 to 30 rabbits needed to be hunted
- More tips & hints added to the loading screen
- Solved an important bug causing game getting stuck when throwing a molotov cocktail to any wild life
- Campfires and torches will now extinguish when they are directly exposed to rain
- Warning! Acid rain will now trigger an explosive reaction when colliding with fire (for now, torches and campfires, expanding this to the rest of the available game fire)
- You can collect water again by using empty bottles or bowls under the rain
- Staying under rain will now replenish your thirst slowly
- New and experimental chat system, integrated with the new UI
- Chat will now be hiding lines after a few seconds, open it (pressing enter) to see the fully cached text
- Animals will be spawning only at day and hiding at night if they can

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.16a
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Here we are again with new content and fixes for One Last Day.

This time you will find some cool additions and improvements that will improve your game experience.

[h1]Does it sounds good?[/h1]
Sound is important and I'm making some tweaks, adjustements and additions to the sound system.
Now the ambience sound at day will be softer and quiet, and at night, you will hear some crickets and more sounds.
Also sometimes when you were walking over some surfaces, your footsteps sound like grass always. Now this is fixed and in addition I've added a couple of new sounds for metal and wet dirt.
And talking about footsteps sounds, no more ninja zombies! They will make sounds when walking, soft sounds though.

[h1]This looks better, and works better[/h1]
Again we've improved load times and the generation itself. An improved mesh generation for terrain will avoid strange forms and work faster.
Also, some buildings were generating a bit strange too or floating, well, no more!
Now pines are much more beautiful and well generated too.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/betterPines.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved lighting, darker nights[/h1]
Now you should have a couple of torchs or campfires when the night falls, because after 23:00PM it gets really dark until 5:00AM, so better watch your step, find a safe place, get a torch, or do everything.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/darker.jpg[/img]

Also lighting system has been improved, avoiding strange shadows or illumination, and making day / night cycle looking better.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/improvedLight.jpg[/img]

[h1]Just a bit less silly[/h1]
Zombies are quite dumb, and they were doing weird things. They will keep being quite dumb, because that's our goal, but even so we have improved a bit their A.I. Now they will climb up if they can to catch you, so you won't be safe if they find the way.

[h1]And more, much more![/h1]
A new airdrop box, a little clock with in-game time, UI improvements, bug fixes, performance, etc..

Here's the full change list:
- Voxel generation (mesh generation) improved
- Morning load time reduced drastically
- No more boars spawning in the air
- NPC spawn increased (wildlife will be still hard to hunt, but at least there will be quite more to be hunted)
- New box for the airdrops added
- Effect when breaking an airdrop box improved
- Day sound ambience has been changed
- New night sound ambience added
- Lush pine. Improved generation for pines (trees)
- Added store filters to find faster the type of item you want to buy
- Current coins are now showed at the store only
- Added a footstep sound to the zombies
- World generation time improved, it should take a bit less to generate
- World generation: building generation improved, no more "flying" buildings
- Existing player footstep over some materials added
- New player footstep sounds for some materials added
- Some UI adjustements have been done
- WARNING, true dark nights!, now you will need a light source at night if you want to see something
- Now zombies won't attack you while spawning from underground
- Added a clock to the game with the current in-game time
- Solved a bug where the coin was colliding with bullets
- Zombies will now stop with an animation while climbing up
- Object placement (torchs, campfires) is now fixed and should be working as expected


Hope you enjoy this update and what's coming next too!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.14af1 (FIX)
notes.notes:
Hello!

Adding new content take a bit more than doing fixes and optimization. So when I upload a new update, the very next thing to be done are fixes for possible bugs.

That's why I bring you a 0.14a FIX with some bugs fixed and some performance improvement.

[h1]Important!![/h1]
This update contains some major fixes that may require you to create a clean map (new map) or if you want to keep your map, you need to delete the following file:

[i]My Documents > My Games > OLD > "Your map name" > lc.dat[/i]

You will lost any items saved into containers or chests, but the drop FPS, exiting problem and many more things will be fixed.

I didn't make it automatic to avoid making you loose any precious items, at least you will have the chance to try to save them first by saving in your character inventory or moving them to another map container.

[h1]0.14af1 (fix) update[/h1]

- [b]Solved a bug when saving loot causing duplicated loot to be saved[/b]

[h1]And next?[/h1]

notes.title: Next update and further
notes.notes:
Hi!

Are you enjoying the game so far? Well, there's a lot more coming! Be prepared.

Now I'll talk about what's coming on this next update and later.

[h1]Commerce system[/h1]
You have chosen and we did too, so first the system will be in-game driven.
On the very next update you won't be able to access stores yet, but you can collect coins already. These coins are account linked so don't worry if you loose your character or your map, you will keep them always.

[b]How do you get coins so far?[/b]
Every enemy you kill will drop a random ammount of coins in the ground. These coins are not usual items and you only need to walk over them to catch them. Coins will only drop if you made some direct damage to your enemy, so if a zombie gets killed by a lightning, it won't drop any coin.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/coin.png[/img]

Edit.: you will be able to collect these coins by breaking boxes and skeletons too!

[b]And what's next? (on next updates)[/b]
We want to add two kind of stores, the first one is using your antenna, you will be able to buy items by using it. It will have a random list of items that will be updated every day (in-game time).
The second one it's making world stores with NPC vendors. These vendors will be inside a cabin and you won't be able to steal them. Every vendor may have different items, but they will keep the same list.

[h1]Baits and NPC spawn control[/h1]
Some of you have seen that sometimes NPC's are quite expanded around the map, and you need to walk a lot until you find a group of zombies (they were on party).
So I've created the very first game's bait! The Zombie Bait!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/zombieBait.png[/img]

You will be able to craft these bottles and then you can use them as a throwing weapon, like a molotov cocktail. When it breaks, a random number of zombies will spawn around the spot, coming from the underground.

This will be available on the next update coming soon!

So this is a starting bait, we want to add more baits so you can camp and hunt creatures you want.


Hope you like the game so far and what's coming next too!

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: UPDATE # The beginning of a new world
notes.notes:
[h1]This update will change drastically world generation, beware of performance problems and bugs and report them as soon as you can so we can fix it![/h1]

Hey! How are you doing?

Has been a long time without an update, I know, and I apologize, but now I bring you something big.

At first it might seem not a really big update, but we have changed a lot of things that will bring big things!

Let's start with "What's new".

[h1]Building editor[/h1]
My favourite addition to the game. Now you can make your own buildings or even small cities or towns in a editor / creative mode.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor1.jpg[/img]

Fly around freely and start building your own creations. Then, save it and when generating a new map you will have the chance to use your creations into your map randomly!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor2.jpg[/img]

But that's not all, [b]you can share your buildings over the internet with other users and use community made buildings into your new generated maps![/b].

If you made something cool and you think it will be awesome to be included into the game, just press "Share", we will take a look and if everythings is cool, your building is officially into the game!

Making a new map? You will be asked if you want to use community made buildings from the internet, say yes and they will be added randomly! 

[h1]New world generation system[/h1]
Tired of flat, repetitive map? That's over! We have changed the map generation, now you can find hills, different terrain heights and improved building generation.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/newmapgen1.jpg[/img]

The world it's looking the way we wanted, an apocalyptic world that the nature has taken back. Buildings are now procedurally destroyed, move or buried, so the same building you find may be buried, built-in into another building, mostly destroyed and more possibilities!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/night.png[/img]

[h1]Into the depths[/h1]
Another cool feature we have added to the map generator is terrain height and depth, and of course, a cave system.

These caves are quite big and are all over the map, so beware you don't fall into one of them, finding the exit will be hard.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/cave1.jpg[/img]

Caves are a totally new thing, so you can expect cool content and additions to discover in future updates. So far you can explore them, break bones to get loot (like the boxes from the surface), and, another cool thing, explore buried buildings that aren't generated in the surface such bunkers!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/cave2.jpg[/img]

[h1]More?[/h1]
Of course, we have made some fixes and improved stability and performance, however this update might bring some performance spikes.
Also we have solved some kind of bug that were causing FPS dropping a lot after playing the same map for a long time. Now you can play as long as you want!

Main menu has been modified and improved with new sounds, options and more, take a look.

[h1]Things removed / deactivated[/h1]
We have deactivated surface water temporary, you can still find water in pools and underground, at the bottom of the map. The reason is that we're developing dynamic water like very voxel game.

[h1]Future content[/h1]
Expect imminent content for the underground, new buildings, fixes and some surprises!
Also we're going to add support for OSX (Mac) soon. Then, Linux!


[h1]Discount[/h1]
The game will be greatly discounted for 14 days. This is a great opportunity for all those players that weren't sure enough to spend 13$ on a unfinished game, you will be able to get it for a much lower price.

However, to be fair to the users that bought the game before for the whole price they will get some exclusive items in a future.

Scavenger weapons are included into this promotion.

[h1]Important[/h1]
Big update, you need to update to keep playing. Update avaiable on next hours, keep the game updated!

notes.title: More news about the update
notes.notes:
Hey!

As you know we're doing a big update.

We're taking a bit more than expected because we want everything smooth and fully working.

I'm here to show you some progress!

[h1]New map generation[/h1]
As you know, there's a new map generator, including new terrain heights, slopes, canyons and a new building distribution. Now the generator may merge even terrain with buildings and / or with other buildings. This adds a perfect feeling of post-apocalyptic world that the nature has taken back!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/generation.png[/img]

I'd like to add that temporary we have deactivated the water and different heights. You can still find water in the underground. This is because we're doing dynamic water and it's taking a bit more.

[h1]Caves and underground[/h1]
Yay! We've added underground generation. You won't find minerals and things like this in the caves, as instead, you will be able to find special herbs, buried old buildings (such as bunkers and so), skeletons, and dangers. We are adding more underground content in future updates!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/underground.png[/img]

[h1]Building / map editor[/h1]
What is the best way to add more content to the game? Letting the community create their own content! Starting from a building editor, you will be able to create your own buildings and then send them to be reviewed and approved.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editorl.png[/img]

Then, every user will be able to allow the map generator to take random buildings from the internet and generate a new map using them!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor2.png[/img]

Please note that the interface and some other things are not finished yet and may be changed this week!

[h1]Performance[/h1]
This is serious for us. We're trying to keep improving the game's performance, and we're doing well. In this version you will find that the game no longer crash or take too many memory after playing the same map for a long time.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We want to add farming in this update too, let's see if that's possible, but it will be soon.
After the update, we are going to make this version stable and we'll keep adding new content to the map, but most important we're going back to player interactions, items and so.

We want to thank you all for your support, let's keep improving the game!

notes.title: [UPCOMING] Let's talk about the next update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ^^

We'd like to talk about the next update and the current state of the game.
Right now this version is quite stable, as for a few bugs. 

This bugs or unfinished features will be fully removed and / or changed in the next updates. Since they aren't killing the gameplay or making the game unplayable, we're focused on the biggest content that will fix them too.

Now, what's coming on One Last Day?

[h1]Natural world[/h1]
If you purchased the game on day 1, at launch you might remember that the terrain was a bit...ugly and unrealistic. After an update we improved the generation a lot, making it more realistic, but this is not enough!
We're bringing soon slopes, canyons and and different terrain levels. Also caves and underground system is planned.

[h1]Harder to survive[/h1]
Take a walk right now, you will see a thousand mushroom and food around you. This make survival quite easy, so we are moving things a bit, for example, mushrooms will be spawning a lot underground and a bit over the surface under trees. You will need to explore a bit more if you want more resources.

[h1]Farming[/h1]
Have you a home? Then make your own food. You will be able to farm starting with a few crops, we are adding more on future updates!

[h1]Buildings everywhere?[/h1]
Right now you can see high buildings everywhere. You will be able to find them in this update too, but instead, the bigger buildings will be together on a kind of a destroyed city or towns. Far away, at forests, mountains and so you will be able to find smaller buildings.

[h1]Dangerous wildlife[/h1]
Better don't bother a wild boar...

All these features will allow us to make even more features like cooking, improved crafting, and more!

And when is all of this coming?
We're planning to release a big update after the summer sale with all these features and maybe more, stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE #6: More content and optimization!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
This update is quite big after all, read it please! You will find useful information.

We come with new things to be played.

While we are working on a bigger patch that will bring bigger additions to the game (keep an eye, we'll talk about it soon) we're releasing smaller content. Some was already done but pending to be implemented, some is totally new.

Let's start!

[h1]Your own chest[/h1]
First, and finally, you can craft your own chests or boxes to store your things wherever you want with up to 7 slots.
In order to craft it you will need 5 processed wood, 5 scrap and 3 ropes.
No need of wood support to be placed, craft and place!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/cofre.png[/img]

[h1]Climbing time[/h1]
Also finally you can craft your own ladders. They can be placed directly and can be climbed like ivy. Just be careful, it's really weak.
To craft them you only need 2 processed wood and 2 ropes.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/escaleras.png[/img]

[h1]Safe is good[/h1]
And more craftable objects! Now you can craft windows to place them wherever you want. We recommend using the rounded placing mode (by clicking the mouse wheel).
There are 2 kind of windows, both can be closed and opened like a door.
First, the basic, a wooden window
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/window.png[/img]
Craft them with 4 processed wood and 5 nails

And if you like the views, then you have to choose this one
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/windowbars.png[/img]
Just be warned that the bullets can go through the bars. You can craft them with 2 processed wood, 3 nails and 5 scrap.

[h1]Keep your enemies away[/h1]
And now you can craft (also!) throwing knives!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/throwingKnife.png[/img]
They are really useful and can be crafted by just using a stick, a stone and a rope. Cheap and good. [b]However, if you only have the stone, you can throw them too now![/b].
[b]An advice:[/b] use stones or knives to detonate the grenade from the armored zombie's belt.

[h1]This is mine![/h1]
This is a small thing, but important. You can recover now almost every arrow, stone or knife you throw or shoot. Really useful.

[h1]More notes[/h1]
There are a lot of changes and additions in this patch. Some of most important that you should care about are these:
- Airplane drops now last 450 seconds instead of 150
- Parachute from drop boxes have changed to a more visible model
- Solved some bugs involved with inventory and free slots
- Arrows wont damage armored zombies anymore
- Arrows, throwing knives and stones may now detonate the grande from the armored zombie's belt
[b]- Added a breaking indicator effect on voxel (cracks)[/b]
- Breaking voxel effect improved

[h1]This patch is quite big, so you may expect some fixes soon as it's needed.[/h1]

[h1]Patch available on next 20 minutes. Version changed to 0.11a, you need to update to keep playing.[/h1]

notes.title: UPDATE #5: New content, fixes and optimization
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Like I said, here is it! Another update but this time with more content.
Then let's talk about what is new. Starting with a new map generation.

[h1]Map generation[/h1]
This new map generation is right now pretty similar to the previous, however it will allow much more control and future implementations. Also, the generated terrain is now much more realistic and with less water! More to explore.
Ah, and no more floating buildings over the water.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/bettergen.png[/img]

[h1]New animal type[/h1]
Introducing the pheasant! New winged animal implemented. It was done before, but not implemented. Now you can hunt flying birds.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/pheasantNew.png[/img]

[h1]Airdrops / first map event[/h1]
Yay! Now you can have an airplane dropping resources over your map at morning (9 AM). It will drop weapons and supplies.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/supplieairplane.png[/img]

In order to get the airplane flying around, you need to craft an antenna first, and to do so you need Scrap and a Transmitter, that you can get from Armored Zombies. Then place your new antenna anywhere and the airplane will fly around every morning.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/antenna.png[/img]

The airplane will drop two kind of boxes, supplies and weapons. This boxes contains a higher drop for those items that you can get in the world but only if you are lucky. Also it may contain exclusive things like a placeable mine!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/mineNew.png[/img]


[h1]More things![/h1]
- Buildings will no longer keep generating over the water
- NPC limit added to the map 
- Character stuck (animation) fixed
- Now you need to generate the map in order to save it
- Lightnings effect optimized, no more FPS drops
- Blood effect optimized
- Break block effect changed
- New item added: transmitter, dropped by armored zombies
- New recipe added: antenna, craftable with scrap (20) and transmitters (2)

[b]Version changed to 0.1pa, you need to update your game in order to keep playing[/b]

[h1]Important[/h1]
This update is bigger than usual, please, keep your game updated for possible fixes.

Update available on Steam in 10-15 minutes.

notes.title: UPDATE #3: Bug fixes and optimization
notes.notes:
Hi!

3 days since launch and 3 patches! Well I think I need some resting now...lol

This patch includes some fixes but we have more fixes to be done yet. Lets see the changes

- [b]Block screen and mouse.[/b] Your mouse is now locked while aiming mode (for window, non exclusive mode). You can unlock it with Alt.
- [b]Keys changed.[/b] By popular demand, some keys have been changed. Now the tablet (menu) can be dragged with Tab, and weapons can be hidden by pressing the same key you pressed to show them.
- Water splash reduced. You aren't anymore a zodiac =D
- Blood effect changed.
- [b]Zombies are now more dangerous.[/b] They can climb 1 block, you need to be higher if you want to avoid them. (Animation to be done)
- Zombie performance improved.
- Climbing bug (not allowing jump) solved.
- Some tablet bugs have been solved.
- Some stack problems and item duplication fixed.
- You can't attack, shoot or drag tablet anymore while the screen is locked.
- Some UI windows have been adjusted and centered.

This patch includes some fixes but we have more fixes to be done yet. Lets see the changes

- [b]Keys changed.[/b] By popular demand, some keys have been changed. Now the tablet (menu) can be dragged with Tab, and weapons can be hidden by pressing the same key you pressed to show them.
- Water splash reduced. You aren't anymore a zodiac =D
- Blood effect changed.
- [b]Zombies are now more dangerous.[/b] They can climb 1 block, you need to be higher if you want to avoid them. (Animation to be done)
- Zombie performance improved.
- Climbing bug (not allowing jump) solved.
- Some tablet bugs have been solved.
- Some stack problems and item duplication fixed.
- You can't attack, shoot or drag tablet anymore while the screen is locked.
- Some UI windows have been adjusted and centered.

notes.title: Bug fixing and next update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We hope you all are enjoying the game.

We are aware about the crashing thing while playing around 40-60 mins and we're working to fix it as soon as possible.

But that's not all. We promised content update every 2 weeks but this bug fixing patch is bringing new content too. Be ready to hide from the acid rain, lightnings and find the loot that the plane dropped at the morning!


[b]Something at work[/b]
And something else that I'd like to say is that the tablet system (yep, that awesome "Zablet") is being redesigned for a more confortable and intuitive way to use it.

We're also redesigning the character's control, this will allow new weapon types (some surprises) and interactions.

And about the multiplayer, you can currently start your game with your own server by routing the 25000 port to your private IP. If you ever made a server game for a sandbox game you will know how to do it.
However you might not, that's because we're working to bring a "Server search" feature, and hopefully to make some dedicated servers soon.

Thank you!!
